content: Go libp2p gossipsub master (libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub) hardening constants, read directly from gossipsub.go: GossipSubD=6, Dlo=5, Dhi=12, Dscore=4, Dout=2, HistoryLength=5, HistoryGossip=3, Dlazy=6, FanoutTTL=60s, GossipSubMaxIHaveLength=5000, GossipSubMaxIHaveMessages=10. NOTE: GossipSubMaxSubscriptions does NOT exist in master gossipsub.go (checked; not a real parameter) - subscription bounding is instead via RPC size caps DefaultMaxMessageSize=1MiB and DefaultMaxControlMessageSize=512KiB with dropIfOversized in pubsub.go. Oversized-RPC handling drops with tracer.DropRPC.
